CVE-2026-58010.current_use_proof: No exact external consumer imports g_variant_is_normal_form or g_variant_get_normal_form. GdkPixbuf is the sole external consumer importing variant construction: gdk_pixbuf_serialize makes PNG bytes itself, marks a bytestring trusted, and constructs a new (sv) tuple. Its GResource imports only look up/open already-registered resource content; no external consumer imports g_resource_load, g_resource_new_from_data, g_resources_register, or g_static_resource_init. No first-party GVariant/GResource binding exists and the complete OS inventory contains no external .gresource/gschemas.compiled files. This excludes an application upload being interpreted as serialized GVariant tuple data.
CVE-2026-58010.trigger: Normality-checking attacker-supplied serialized GVariant tuple data with malformed padding.

CVE-2026-58011.current_use_proof: No inspected consumer, including the GLib-owned GIO/gobject/helper ELF members, imports g_date_time_add_full. The exact gdatetime.c source has no call to that function outside its own definition. GIO imports g_date_time_add, creation, formatting and scalar accessors; these do not route into add_full. No first-party GLib/GDateTime binding exists.
CVE-2026-58011.trigger: g_date_time_add_full constructs an invalid date that reaches g_date_time_get_ymd.

CVE-2026-58012.current_use_proof: No inspected external or GLib-owned consumer imports g_regex_replace or g_match_info_expand_references. GIO uses g_regex_new, g_regex_split and g_regex_replace_literal. Exact source implements literal replacement through literal_replacement and g_regex_replace_eval, which does not interpret case-change escapes. No first-party GRegex binding exists.
CVE-2026-58012.trigger: G_REGEX_RAW replacement using case-changing replacement escapes reaches string_append UTF-8 stepping.

CVE-2026-58013.current_use_proof: No inspected consumer imports g_io_channel_set_line_term. GdkPixbuf opens its loader-module cache and reads lines without setting a terminator. The exact GLib channel initializer sets line_term NULL; its default newline path therefore applies. GIO also imports read_line but not set_line_term. No first-party GIOChannel binding exists.
CVE-2026-58013.trigger: A GIOChannel line read after configuring a custom terminator longer than one byte.

CVE-2026-58014.current_use_proof: No external consumer imports this function. The GLib-owned GIO use is loading desktop application Keywords in g_desktop_app_info_load_from_keyfile. No current consumer imports desktop application or application-info APIs. The graphics GFile paths do not load desktop metadata; the shipped GLib schema compiler calls other key-file accessors. No first-party GKeyFile/GDesktopAppInfo binding exists.

CVE-2026-58015.current_use_proof: No external consumer imports g_dbus_* or g_bus_* entry points. GIO remains a shipped library but the current graphics callers use its file/resource operations. The complete OS inventories have no GIO modules/GVfs implementation; the exact default local VFS handles file paths and has no DBus transport. No first-party GDBus binding or PyGObject/dbus Python distribution exists. Presence of separate libdbus-1-3 does not establish a GDBus client path.
CVE-2026-58015.trigger: A GDBus client authenticates to a malicious server with DBUS_COOKIE_SHA1 and accepts a traversing cookie_context.

CVE-2026-58016.current_use_proof: No external consumer imports the introspection parser or other g_dbus_*/g_bus_* entry points; no first-party GDBus binding exists. Rendering/XML ingestion uses different parsers and does not pass documents into DBus introspection. GIO local file/resource calls and installed libdbus do not invoke this API.
CVE-2026-58016.trigger: g_dbus_node_info_new_for_xml parses malformed DBus introspection XML with a node nested in a method/signal/property/arg.

CVE-2026-76957.current_use_proof: All exact OS Expat consumers (fontconfig and Mesa GBM/GLX/Gallium) were inspected; none imports XML_SetUnknownEncodingHandler or contains that lookup string. They use Expat built-in encodings and cannot install convert/release callbacks through the public API. First-party XML routes use defusedxml/ElementTree/mwxml or lxml; native-hook search found only unrelated eSpeak library discovery and curl-cffi messages. Exact pure-Python mwxml 0.3.8, defusedxml 0.7.1, et_xmlfile 2.0.0 contain no native callback hooks. CPython 3.11.16 and 3.12.14 pyexpat default handlers both assign convert/release NULL, and both _elementtree implementations install that default. lxml uses libxml2/libxslt. Therefore the custom callback prerequisite is absent for observed current callers even if Python were linked to OS Expat.
CVE-2026-76957.scope_caveat: CPython source is bound to pinned Dockerfile interpreter versions, not a runtime/bundled-Expat observation. This finding covers only the two OS libexpat1 records and does not label other Expat copies fixed or safe. Expat76956 entropy proof is not reused.
CVE-2026-76957.trigger: An application-provided XML_Encoding.convert or XML_Encoding.release callback reenters the same Expat parser without handler-depth protection.
